twoFactor.enabledDescription: Waa la shaqaynayaa — soo gelitaanka wuxuu sidoo kale u baahan yahay far-raadkaaga, Face unlock, ama koodh backup ah.

twoFactor.backupCodesDialogDescription: Koodh kastaa hal mar buu shaqeeyaa, marka qalabkaagu aanu la heli karin. Meel ammaan ah ku kaydi — mar dambe lama muujin doono.
